title: Recursive true-output cost bound
statement: For every natural number $d$, the recursively defined randomized NAND decision tree has cost for output $-1$ at depth $d+1$ at most its cost for output $1$ at depth $d$ plus half its cost for output $-1$ at depth $d$.
